result.topic_en: Euler shows that the quadratic residues modulo a prime 2n+1 are exactly the even powers of a primitive root, so they number n, half of the nonzero residues, with an equal number of non-residues. A scholion extends this to cubes and to arbitrary λ-th powers, whose residues coincide with those of the geometric progression 1, a^λ, a^{2λ}, ….

items.english: In a similar way it can be shown that the residues arising from the division of cubes do not differ from those belonging to the geometric progression 1, a^3, a^6, a^9, a^12 etc., where a always denotes a primitive root.

items.english: And in general, if any powers of numbers 1, 2^λ, 3^λ, … are divided by a prime number P, the residues arising from them will be the same as those arising from this geometric progression: 1, a^λ, a^{2λ}, ….
